description: Mixpanel group profile updates posted to /groups. /track is vendor/mixpanel. /import is vendor/mixpanel-import. /engage is vendor/mixpanel-engage.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Mixpanel documents `verbose=1` so the 200 body says whether the update was accepted.
params.fix_hint: Send `verbose=1` on `/groups` while you are implementing.

params.name: strict
params.description: Mixpanel documents `strict=1` so failed records are named in the response.
params.fix_hint: Send `strict=1` to see per-record validation errors.

params.name: ip
params.description: Mixpanel documents `ip=0` on server-side calls so the group profile is not geolocated to your server.

params.name: data
params.description: The official browser SDK encodes the event or profile update in data for the legacy base64 transport.
The JSON body is a nonempty array of records.

params.name: $token
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$token` as required. It is the project token.
params.fix_hint: Send the project token from Mixpanel project settings as `$token`.

params.name: $group_key
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$group_key` as required. It is the group type, such as Company.
params.fix_hint: Send the group key you configured in Mixpanel, such as `Company`.

params.name: $group_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$group_id` as required. It is the group instance, such as Acme.
params.fix_hint: Send the id of this group, such as `acme`.

params.name: $set
params.description: Updates or adds group properties, creating the profile if needed.

params.name: $set_once
params.description: Sets group properties only when they are not already set.

params.name: $add
params.description: Increments numeric group properties.

params.name: $union
params.description: Unions list group properties.

params.name: $remove
params.description: Removes values from list group properties.

params.name: $unset
params.description: Unsets named group properties.

params.name: $delete
params.description: Deletes the group profile.
The vendor documents `` in the request contract.

params.name: $unset[]
params.description: The vendor documents `$unset[]` in the request contract.

params.name: increment
params.description: The vendor documents `increment` in the request contract.

params.name: union
params.description: The vendor documents `union` in the request contract.

rules.message: The group update has no operation. Mixpanel documents `$set`, `$set_once`, `$add`, `$union`, `$remove`, `$unset`, or `$delete`.
rules.fix_hint: Send `$set` with the properties to write, or another documented groups operator.
